svg.title: spec_manager generated SPEC analysis workflow
svg.desc: Synthetic generator creates an out.spec file and scan-list CSV. The parser reads scan metadata and numeric columns. Plotting scripts produce rocking curves and Gaussian peak width versus Q; old parsing code is now also in QoraGeom.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK KR, Malgun Gothic, Arial, sans-serif
Noto Sans CJK KR, Malgun Gothic, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A generated input lets you explore the parser without using measured beamtime files.
